title: Code and data for: Resonant enhancement and source priors shape subwavelength acoustic reconstruction
description: Companion code, reduced measurements, frozen inputs, Source Data and validation for the final 14 November 2026 manuscript. Supports five main figures, nine supplementary figures and Supplementary Notes 1–17. Includes eighteen original prior-network checkpoints, all 210 catalogue test phasors, frozen catalogue network classifications and their training recipe, and complete covariance-analysis inputs. The six original catalogue U-Net weights were not saved upstream. Forty selected raw waveforms are supplied; other raw time series are excluded. See README.md and REPRODUCTION_REPORT.json for scope and validation.
